prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of deep polar ocean — abyssal blue-black water
with faint swell patterns catching pale slate highlights. Restrained,
cold, vast.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, orthographic top-down view of abyssal polar ocean filling the frame, deep blue-black water with faint swell patterns catching pale slate highlights on aged vellum parchment.

subjects.description: Abyssal polar ocean, top-down orthographic, loose ink swell lines radiating across the tile, cold slate highlights on dark rolling water.
subjects.position: fills entire frame edge to edge

subjects.description: Faint crescent brushstrokes of pale slate catching light across wave ridges, sparse and restrained, watercolor wash barely lifted from darkness.
